messages:
maria.s: Quick handoff for Kepler Analytics (mid-market, ~250 seats). Signed for Private deployment (VPC). Main asks: SAML SSO (Okta), EU data residency, custom Snowflake connector to ingest their event stream, and a webhook for inference logs. Go‑live target: 2026-05-15 (alpha). Renewal in 12 months — high risk if integration slips. Contact: sara@kepler.ai (CTO). Committed to reserved capacity monthly. Attaching sales notes + PO stub.
priya (CSM): Thanks Maria — I'm taking CSM ownership. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with Kepler and owners. Need ENG for the Snowflake connector spike and security review, and Support for runbook/oncall. @dan can you pick up the connector spike? @olivia can you own the runbook + escalation matrix?
dan (Eng): I can own the connector spike. ETA: 2 weeks for a spike + security checklist. I'll need a dev Snowflake account + sample schema and sample rows. @maria.s please get dev creds and example data. Also flagging potential Private subnet egress rules.
olivia (Support): I'll draft the production runbook and a short escalation matrix. I also want a pre-prod SSO test plan. Any compliance docs from Kepler? If they require audits we should add that to onboarding tasks.
deploy-bot: Created ENG-4721 (Snowflake connector spike) and SUP-1182 (runbook + SSO test plan).
priya (CSM): Action owners & deadlines: dan -> ENG-4721 (spike) due 2026-04-20; olivia -> SUP-1182 due 2026-04-22; priya -> customer kickoff 2026-04-15; maria.s -> provide dev creds + PO + vendor questionnaire by 2026-04-10. I'll schedule enablement/training week of 2026-04-25 (recording + FAQ). Tagging finance to confirm billing alignment for reserved capacity.
maria.s: I'll send dev creds and PO by EOD Thu. Kepler legal asked for our vendor questionnaire — here's the link to the template. They also asked about quantization profiles — told them default profiles are OK for now.
dan (Eng): Got it. Also: if Kepler streams events we should verify schema for nested JSON types; CSV samples preferred to speed spike. I'll include infra notes about NAT/egress rules in ENG-4721.
olivia (Support): Noted quarterly audit requirement on the legal note — adding to onboarding checklist. I'll prepare a one‑pager escalation matrix and a runbook template for the kickoff.
priya (CSM): I'll update the account doc with this summary and owners, and create a public checklist for the team. Everyone OK with timelines? :thumbsup:
maria.s: :thumbsup:
dan (Eng): :+1:
olivia (Support): :thumbsup:
